parsed.explanation: Parent regime creates traveler-facing birth-sex facility exclusion in federal buildings and, in this division, public schools/colleges/universities expanded May 2026, with document/entry mismatch risk including refusal and a possible fraud finding, plus documented hormone denial in custody and severe immigration-custody abuse nationally. These are tier-1 exposures if outed/detained. Mitigating: no trans-presentation criminalisation or organised visitor targeting documented, and courts have enjoined some measures and protected a student plaintiff's bathroom access during litigation, showing partial recourse. The division is assessed as escalating, not harshest tier. Hostile national framing and public support for birth-sex documents increase risk, while resident-only gaps such as no state hate-crime statute and an unrepealed sodomy law are not counted heavily.
